name: rust-crate-fqn-distinct
body: No two local crates of the same Cargo package may render the same module FQN. A package that declares both a library target and a binary target with the same target name — the default lib+bin package, e.g. `[package] name = "apg"` producing lib target `apg` and bin target `apg` — must give each crate a distinct, stable module prefix, so the two crate roots render distinct module FQNs and `apg scan` completes without a `duplicate project node FQN` panic. Distinctness is a property of the rendered module identity, not of any particular disambiguation scheme: any scheme that yields distinct, stable prefixes satisfies it.
